messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — vendor alerted us that a subset of A100 racks in eu-west1 are scheduled for a soft decommit next Tue 03:00 UTC. Could we do a quick impact check on reserved pools? Link to vendor note: https://vendor.example/notice/73 :warning:

elaine: Which pool name? demo or prod?

sanjay: reserved-dedicated-demo-eu is the one called out. They list ~12 GPUs affected (soft first, hard 48h after). Might hit a couple of non-prod tenants and one customer sandbox.

katie: tagging infra bot — @ops-bot can you run a quick allocation summary for that pool and list tenant slices (serials not needed here, just counts)?

ops-bot: Inventory report for reserved-dedicated-demo-eu:

```
pool: reserved-dedicated-demo-eu
total_gpus: 48
allocated_gpus: 36
free_gpus: 12
tenants_allocated: acme-inc, sandbox-team, demo-ops
non-prod_slice_percent: 60%
last_sync: 2026-03-19T21:05:12Z
```

vendor-ops: We can delay physical decommission by up to 48h if you provide a serial list and PO reference by EOD. After that it's out of our capacity. Can also offer temporary replacement racks but lead time ~72h.

elaine: I can pull serials, will assemble list and send to vendor-ops by 17:00 UTC today.

katie: Quick capacity question — do we have spare capacity in us-west2 to handle a graceful failover for the sandbox tenants? I see ~8 free there currently.

sanjay: US-West2 has 8 free — not enough to absorb everything but ok for non-prod. Plan: request vendor 48h hold, migrate sandbox-team + demo-ops to us-west2 spots, keep acme-inc on reserved (they're prod-ish) and open a billing escalation if vendor can't hold.

katie: I'll open a tiny PR to update routing policy for those tenant routes and add a canary migration plan. pinging @sanjay for quick review when ready.

vendor-ops: Confirmed — hold available on receipt of serials + PO by EOD. If you need replacement racks, raise a ticket referencing this thread and we'll prioritize 72h.

sanjay: Thanks — plan accepted. Elaine, send serials. Katie, land the PR and I'll approve. If vendor flips to hard decommit, we'll trigger migration. :thumbsup:
